implementation.targetScope: Ninety-seven components: button controls, Typography, Link, SvgIcon, Box, Paper, Divider, Icon, FormControl, FormLabel, FormHelperText, InputBase, Input, OutlinedInput, InputLabel, InputAdornment and the TextField wrapper; createSvgIcon and the scoped resolved-theme bridge. Includes controlled/uncontrolled native inputs, custom slots/refs, autofill state, client-owned textarea measurement, and shared input focus/filled/required/error state, native label and helper accessibility, form theme overrides, surfaces/elevations, horizontal/vertical and labelled dividers, font-icon fallback, current custom-root props, nested/CSS-variable themes and responsive sx. Full Material theme creation and remaining families are not implemented. The independently written List/MenuItem/MenuList/text/icon/subheader foundation and Menu/Popover provide app-used option navigation, anchored placement, modal focus/dismissal and document-scoped scroll ownership. Select now composes the owned inputs and menu stack; TextField select uses it by default. Scalar/multiple values, native mode, form events, labels, keyboard selection and Hook Form integration cover the app callers. Remaining families are not implemented. Checkbox and FormControlLabel independently cover WARML confirmations, authentication and table selection, including native mixed state, labels, checked ownership, form reset, slots/refs and theme overrides. Radio/RadioGroup and FormGroup cover team-choice and settings forms, native keyboard navigation, generated names, group focus and controlled/uncontrolled selection. Switch covers existing WARML, family reminder and Fuse preference callers with native input semantics, five slots, compact app theme overrides and controlled/uncontrolled state. Chip covers status/award labels, clickable preference tags, navigation badges, multiline statuses and draggable/removable roommate labels. Avatar covers profile images, initials, activity photos and roommate Chip adornments, including the shared app size override. CircularProgress covers contest results, Mustang exam loading and WARML submission states with current range/track APIs, native progress accessibility, theme overrides and reduced-motion rendering. Skeleton covers shared Fuse loading, contest archives/exams/search and WARML practice/signup shapes, responsive sizes, theme/RTL overrides, child measurement and motion preferences. Container covers public results, article pages and contest/WARML forms: responsive caps, fixed widths, gutters, theme defaults/overrides, sx, custom roots and refs. Card and CardContent compose the owned Paper surface for app contest panels, WARML signup/practice and club articles, with raised/elevation/outlined states, content spacing, theme overrides, responsive sx, custom roots and refs. CardActionArea independently composes owned ButtonBase for router-linked club articles and Math Is Cool exams, with hover/focus overlays, current slots, themes, refs and keyboard semantics. AvatarGroup covers grouped avatars, overlap, max/total overflow, custom surplus slots/rendering, theme styles, roots and stable child identity. Tooltip covers app navigation hints, rich role/source notes, sync warnings and controlled copy notices, with owned Floating UI positioning, hover/focus/touch timers, document-local portals, descriptions, arrows, slot props and theme styles. Collapse independently composes the owned VPM Transition lifecycle for navigation groups and exam previews, with measured height/width transitions, automatic timing from the resolved theme, cancellation, reduced-motion policy, custom slots, refs and stable child identity. DialogTitle, DialogContent and DialogActions independently provide heading semantics, title-context IDs, bounded scrolling, dividers and action spacing. Dialog now independently owns portals, title IDs, focus containment/restoration, nested overlay ownership, scroll locks, guarded dismissal, responsive paper and cancellable fade transitions. Custom caller transitions remain injectable. Slide independently provides wrapper-free child transitions, viewport/container edge placement, callback/ref forwarding, reduced-motion timing, cancellation and closed-content resize tracking, including both app settings-panel Dialog extension forms. DialogContentText composes owned Typography for external-link and WARML confirmations, including IDs, semantic/custom roots, theme defaults/overrides, palette colors and sx. Drawer independently composes owned Paper, Slide and document-local modal primitives for permanent, persistent and temporary panels, four edges and RTL, portals, keyboard dismissal, focus restoration, retained content, slots, refs and themes. SwipeableDrawer composes owned Drawer with touch-close/open requests, hysteresis/fling decisions, scroll arbitration, physical edges/RTL, cancellable document-local gesture ownership, retained content, current slots and refs. Table primitives cover contestant/ARML/IMO/WARML result grids: semantic sections/cells, sticky headers, size/padding inheritance, sort accessibility, selected/hover rows, scroll containers and theme overrides. Autocomplete covers app-used school/free-solo and student/object selectors with controlled value/input/open state, filtering, multiple Chip values, keyboard navigation, disabled choices, owner-document portals and Hook Form integration. TableSortLabel, PaginationItem, Pagination and usePagination independently provide keyboard sorting and bounded page windows for the app’s numbered Material React Table pagination, including controlled state, localization, current-page accessibility, custom item roots, RTL arrows and resolved themes. LinearProgress covers ARML loading, WARML seat-capacity bars and the adopted Material React Table loading indicator, including determinate/buffer ranges, indeterminate/query animation, RTL and resolved themes. Alert and AlertTitle cover app severity notices, actions and close callbacks plus the adopted table selection/error banner. Badge covers the reading-list toolbar count. ListItemButton composes owned ButtonBase and list context for native/router navigation, dense text, selected/disabled/focus states, theme and RTL styling. AppBar and Toolbar cover shell headers/footers, palette settings and messenger toolbars with Paper composition, responsive gutters/heights, colors, positioning, dark/CSS-variable themes and app theme overrides. AccordionSummary and AccordionDetails cover the contest/article summary button and detail layout, including context expansion/disabled/gutter state, slots, refs, theme overrides and native keyboard semantics. Accordion composes owned Paper, Collapse and the summary context for WARML, HMMT and article panels. Includes fixed-layout Tab and Tabs. Includes collapsible breadcrumb navigation. Snackbar announces clipboard confirmation with controlled dismissal and a pausable timeout. Stack uses VPM System for responsive layouts and VentiMath’s Material 7 direct alignment and wrapping props. Grid lays out IMO archive year cards and loading placeholders with responsive spans and theme spacing. Whole-star Rating covers WARML practice-time and relay-position preferences. GlobalStyles applies page, navigation and shell theme rules and scopes the preview stylesheet to its iframe. ClickAwayListener dismisses toolbar search and sidebar panels, with document-local subscriptions and React portal containment. Grow animates both horizontal navigation menu panels with height-based timing, lifecycle callbacks and cancellation on direction changes. Popper anchors both toolbar search suggestion panels using VPM Floating DOM. Slider provides the horizontal scalar font-size control with seven labeled marks. Includes the WARML registration step indicator. Includes Academy’s vertical StepContent subtitles. ListItem covers toolbar event, note and settings rows. CssBaseline applies the root theme through the active Emotion cache. Material styles exposes the eleven public System color helpers for palette contrast and adjustment. Independent palette creation covers mode defaults, role augmentation, custom ramps and nested overrides used by the app theme settings. Independent typography creation covers the app Geist font stack, 13px scaling, explicit body sizes, variants, responsive overrides and palette callbacks. Independent transition creation covers page margins, side-panel dimensions and toolbar effects. Theme assembly composes all owned theme stages and CSS-variable schemes used by VentiMath.
implementation.remainingWork: remaining form controls; default FilledInput if needed; remaining display/navigation/overlay APIs; full Material theme creation; whole-app integration and consumer release.
implementation.transitionCreation: Independent easing/duration defaults, transition strings and capped height timing. Covers unchanged FusePageCarded, FusePageSimple, FuseSearch and FuseSidePanel expressions; connected to the fallback theme. Used by the owned Material theme factory.
implementation.themeAssembly: Independent createTheme for 37 app presets, palette contrast/border passes, CSS prefixes, scheme selectors, spacing, typography, transitions, toolbar mixins and component options. Native CSS color-space theme generation is excluded.

changes: Written independently over VPM System and its styling closure; no upstream Material runtime, Babel or prop-types ships.
Native button semantics and direct React rendering; no imperative HTML insertion.
Owned refs and ripple timers are released on unmount; theme changes retain control DOM.
Independent Typography, Link and SvgIcon plus createSvgIcon; no Material runtime dependency. Actual current/app Material icon modules render unchanged above the VPM factory.
Retains Material 7 paragraph, direct system props and CSS/palette-path colors needed by existing callers alongside the current typography contract. Physical text alignment is preserved in RTL.

Explicit root accessibility attributes override nested SVG attributes; titleAccess promotes a decorative SVG child to a named image unless the root explicitly hides it. Prototype-named variants and sizes do not read inherited object properties.

Custom component roots receive native button type/disabled semantics by default, matching Material 9; nativeButton:false explicitly selects ARIA semantics. Browser acceptance covers the application combination of IconButton, motion.button, inherited variants, theme rerenders and ref cleanup.

Independent Material Box and scoped theme bridge, including $$material isolation, nested callback providers and CSS-variable themes. Retains direct System props used by app 7.2.0, which current Material 9 removed. Fuse-style SVG sprite roots are browser checked.
Independent Paper, Divider and Icon use VPM System. Standard shadow geometry is design data obtained from the public default-theme API; no upstream component runtime is copied.

Paper preserves caller shadow/overlay variables and theme overrides; invalid noninteger or out-of-range elevations reject explicitly. Divider preserves separator roles/orientation and legacy app light/vertical-children hooks. Font icons remain decorative unless explicitly exposed.

Box now forwards custom-root API props such as Icon color/fontSize instead of consuming them as System styles, matching Material 9. App Material 7 has the collision; the browser fixture asserts this intentional difference. Native roots retain app direct System props.

Independent FormControl state provider and useFormControl; FormLabel and FormHelperText inherit only undefined options, preserve explicit false, expose native label/helper semantics and reset stale focus on disable. Initial filled/adornment state supports recognized Input/Select children for SSR. Shared provider identity across CJS/ESM context entries; no upstream input code ships.

Independent InputBase renders native inputs and textareas over VPM styles and FormControl context. Preserves value ownership, input/slot prop precedence, refs and React Hook Form callbacks; follows Material9 native input aria-label placement. Native slot roots do not leak the internal classes object. Multiline measurement is a client-owned node in the field ownerDocument with width-sensitive ResizeObserver scheduling and cleanup; no hidden mirror is serialized into SSR. Measurement lifetime follows the live DOM ref, including custom-root replacement, rather than only the outer component lifetime.

Independent standard Input and OutlinedInput compose the owned InputBase engine. Includes underline focus/error/disabled states, outlined fieldset/legend notch, initial value and adornment form state, required labels, current outline slots and legacy app padding overrides. Native slot roots omit internal ownerState and classes attributes that upstream can leak. No upstream Material runtime is included.

InputLabel inherits live shrink/focus/filled/adornment state with explicit overrides, native labels and required asterisks. InputAdornment supports string typography, custom roots, pointer behavior and isolated child form context. Both preserve app theme overrides, CSS variables, RTL and refs.

TextField composes independent standard/outlined inputs, labels and helper text with generated or explicit IDs, validation, multiline sizing, modern slots and legacy app aliases. Current Material 9 non-native select label semantics are preserved. Select now uses the owned default; FilledInput still requires a custom input slot. Caller-supplied select/input slots remain verified, and no upstream runtime is shipped.

List/menu foundation: current9 keyboard/spacing semantics, retained app7 standalone MenuItem and typography/menu aliases, independent Menu/Popover positioning and document-scoped ownership. No upstream runtime ships. Custom transition slots and exact Grow/exit animation trajectories are outside this verified menu contract.

Independent Select and native select mode compose owned inputs, MenuItem and Menu/Popover. TextField dropdowns work by default, including scalar/numeric/multiple values, displayEmpty, custom rendering, grouped options, controlled opening, keyboard/label focus, hidden form inputs and React Hook Form. Current Material 9 ARIA naming/readOnly semantics are retained. Default-valued TextField labels are already raised in SSR instead of waiting for a client effect. FilledInput and the existing general popup/transition exclusions remain outside this scope.

Independent Checkbox and FormControlLabel use owned ButtonBase, SvgIcon, Typography and FormControl. Material glyph paths are design data obtained from public rendered SVG output; no upstream component runtime is copied. Current9 native indeterminate state and wrapper semantics are retained; app7 inputRef/inputProps and typography aliases remain supported. Native form reset resynchronizes both the icon and React-observed checked property, including later clicks and canceled resets; upstream controls leave the icon stale. Native input owns focus, labels, validation and form submission. Unchanged upstream Radio/Switch verify FormControlLabel composition only; Radio and Switch now have independent implementations.

Independent Radio, RadioGroup, useRadioGroup and FormGroup. Native inputs own selection/navigation; explicit radio props override group defaults. Stable generated names isolate groups. Group actions focus the selected enabled input. Native reset restores an uncontrolled group default, honors cancellation and emits no change callback. Public Material SVG geometry is credited design data. Current/app SSR and browser comparisons exercise WARML and settings Controllers.

Independent Switch composes owned ButtonBase and form context. Current Material9 switch role, track/thumb geometry and public theme overrides are preserved; app7 inputRef/inputProps remain supported. Native reset resynchronizes the thumb and input, and honors cancellation. Top-level Fuse ARIA labels also reach the native input unless explicitly overridden there. No upstream Switch runtime is copied.

Independent Chip composes owned ButtonBase and SvgIcon with root/label slots, theme defaults/overrides, filled/outlined colors, avatar/icon adornments and click/delete keyboard behavior. Public Material cancel SVG geometry is credited design data. Disabled deletion is blocked and exposed through ARIA; native slot roots omit ownerState. No upstream Chip runtime is read or copied.

Independent Avatar uses rendered-image load/error events and completion state, without an extra Image preloader. Request identities suppress stale failures and release on unmount; new URLs retry after failures. Preserves current/app fallbacks, slots/refs, responsive images, request attributes, theme overrides and hydration. Public Person SVG geometry is credited design data. AvatarGroup is now independently implemented.

Independent CircularProgress over VPM styling: finite ranges, clamped geometry and accessible values, progress track, controlled updates, refs, hydration and CSS-only motion that respects prefers-reduced-motion. Current9 and app7 black-box controls; no upstream runtime source copied.

Independent Skeleton supports text/rectangular/rounded/circular placeholders, pulse/wave/off animations, dimensions, children, polymorphic roots and scoped theme styles. Child measurement is native inert with transparent direct text, including zero; reduced-motion preferences stop both animations. Current9/app7 output controls and real VentiMath prop patterns are checked. No upstream component runtime code is included.

Container is independently implemented over the owned styling/theme bridge. Public API declarations and black-box current9/app7 render observations specify the contract; no upstream Container runtime source is used.

Card and CardContent are independently written over owned Paper/styles, using only public declarations/docs and black-box output comparisons. No upstream Card implementation is read or copied. Shared Paper and Card theme overrides compose; content final-child spacing follows live DOM order.

CardActionArea is independently written from public declarations and black-box output. Native custom slots omit private framework attributes; default roots preserve owned ButtonBase navigation and disabled behavior. No upstream action-area runtime ships.

AvatarGroup is independently written from public declarations/docs and black-box current9/app7 controls, without reading or copying upstream runtime. Stable child keys preserve member DOM/focus during updates; the owned Avatar handles image lifecycle.

Tooltip is independently written from public Material declarations/docs and black-box 9.5.0/7.2.0 controls. No upstream Tooltip, Popper or Grow runtime was read or copied. It composes existing VPM Floating UI, uses native portals and cleans up owned timers/listeners/position observers. Basic CSS entry/exit replaces Grow; arbitrary Popper modifiers and the complete Grow API are outside this verified app scope.

Slide is independently written from public declarations/docs and black-box 9.5.0/7.2.0 behavior. No upstream Slide runtime was read or copied. The owned cancellable transition engine retains child identity; closed viewport/container geometry uses the child owner document, with resize observers cleaned up on open/unmount.

DialogContentText independently composes owned Typography; description IDs, current/app themes, stable nodes/refs, accessibility and hydration are checked. Duplicate upstream class tokens are not repeated.

Drawer is independently written over existing owned Paper, Slide and shared private modal primitives, with no added dependencies. Current Material 9 utility classes and temporary-paper dialog semantics are the default; app 7 legacy PaperProps/SlideProps/ModalProps remain supported. The upstream focus-sentinel DOM is replaced by direct owner-document keyboard handling. Swipeable gestures are not implemented by Drawer. Unlike current Material 9, VPM retains the app 7 disableEscapeKeyDown behavior; callers may also veto dismissal in onClose.

SwipeableDrawer is independently implemented with no new dependency. Passive document touch-start detection installs non-passive move listeners only during a candidate gesture. Native child scrolling wins where it can consume movement; cross-axis gestures, multi-touch and cancellation do not issue dismissal requests. Controlled refusal restores the actual parent state. Paper refs are composed instead of suppressing swipe handling as observed with the current Material 9 control. No upstream swipe runtime was read or copied.

Table primitives are independently written over owned styling and private React contexts, without upstream table runtime or new dependencies. Current/app black-box controls verify native and custom-root roles, heading scope, sorted columns, nested context isolation, styles and stable row/input identity.

Independent Autocomplete composes owned inputs, Chip, Paper, buttons and Floating UI. Current9/app7 black-box comparisons cover 960 SSR/filter cases and native school/student scenarios. Controlled free-solo filtering follows Material9 when it differs from app7. No upstream Autocomplete or useAutocomplete runtime is included.

Independent page-window construction is proportional to the visible window rather than total pages. Invalid noninteger or negative counts/windows reject promptly; manually invoked disabled and ellipsis hook callbacks cannot change pages. Navigation SVG paths are independently drawn. No upstream Material runtime is copied.

Independent LinearProgress uses CSS animation without timers, retains DOM across value changes, provides visible reduced-motion loading, and validates/clamps finite ranges before exposing geometry and ARIA. Current fractional/buffer accessibility is retained; upstream 7 legacy classes are not reproduced. Animation metrics and palette design data are observed public rendering contracts; no upstream component runtime is copied.

Alert and AlertTitle independently compose VPM Paper, Typography, SvgIcon and IconButton. Current 9.5.0 and app 7.2.0 are separate controls. Original decorative SVG symbols deliberately differ in geometry. Supports current slots, themed color/variant state, titles/actions, close callbacks and merged root refs; preserves older severity style-override keys used by the app, without emitting deprecated composite classes. Synthetic unchanged MRT_ToolbarAlertBanner/useMaterialReactTable checks cover selection clearing and explicit error banners. No app writes or adoption claim.

Badge independently implements count caps, zero/dot/explicit invisibility, partial anchors, circular overlap, current CSS variables, color/theme/slot/ref integration and committed visible snapshots for exit transitions. Current mark aria-hidden and physical RTL anchors intentionally follow Material 9; app Material 7 has different decoration and RTL behavior. Adds reduced-motion show/hide and current forced-colors outline checks. Reading-list-shaped keyboard/focus and hydration checks use synthetic counts.

Independent ListItemButton covers Fuse navigation and sidebar links using VPM ButtonBase and list context. It propagates density/alignment without leaking sibling state, preserves native/custom link semantics and refs, and applies current focus/disabled rules. Dense ListItemText now places its dense class only on the root, matching current/app controls. App7 icon min-width and programmatic disabled-click behavior differ from current Material and are explicitly checked.

AccordionSummary and AccordionDetails independently compose owned ButtonBase and styling. Current/app context-state and theme controls, slots/ref cleanup, native keyboard event order and retained DOM/focus are checked.
Document-local suggestions portals track their anchor through result changes, scrolling and viewport resize.
Slider commits the controlled font size after React renders the selected mark.
WARML registration steps use ordered-list semantics and announce the active item with aria-current. Role-dependent labels and theme geometry are checked against the app and current Material controls.
StepContent composes VPM Collapse. The Academy course sidebar keeps subtitle nodes across lesson selection and keyed reordering; collapsed content waits for exit before unmounting.
ListItem shares list density and alignment with its children and positions the toolbar settings switches as secondary actions.
CssBaseline supplies document typography, box sizing, print colors, fullscreen backdrop and optional native color schemes for the application theme.

caller.scope: Navigation actions, contest forms, family area/reminder toggles, palette selector and navbar Fab. Building this subset does not switch VentiMath dependencies. Navigation search and link roots, theme typography and icon sizing, and @mui/icons-material consumers in MustangMath, I2MC and IMO. FuseSvgIcon instead uses styled Box, SVG sprite references and an Icon fallback. Material icons and FuseSvgIcon are distinct callers. Shared external-link actions combine IconButton with motion.button and inherited variants. Paper appears in contest registration/results and public authentication panels; Divider in shared navigation and vertical toolbars; Icon in palette selection and FuseSvgIcon’s non-SVG fallback. Form foundations are used by FuseSettings number/radio/switch controllers and palette selection; the shared theme changes label typography, control color and helper margins. Browser checks use synthetic settings forms and unchanged upstream InputBase through a test-only context bridge. InputBase is an indirect dependency of TextField/table fields, not a direct app import. Audited NumberFormController numeric limits, shared DataTable search/filter styling, ARML multiline preferences and WARML fixed-row contact fields. Synthetic acceptance uses unchanged current/app React Hook Form Controllers. Select callers reviewed at the recorded revision: FamilyRemindersPage schedules, WARML controlled forms, ViewAsDropdown roster switching, and Material React Table scalar/multiple filters. Synthetic browser forms exercise current/app Hook Form without reading live user records. Checkbox/FormControlLabel callers: WARML CompetitionStep/ConfirmStep interest and confirmation Controllers, authentication remember/terms fields, Material React Table header/row/column selection. FormControlLabel also wraps Radio/Switch in WARML and Fuse settings; Radio and Switch are now owned. Radio callers verified at app origin/main 446bc73d: WARML PracticeSignupCard and ArmlRenoSection, FuseSettings RadioFormController; synthetic data only. Switch inventory at the same revision: WARML AboutYouStep email preferences, FamilyRemindersPage, FuseSettings/SwitchFormController and QuickPanel. Calendar EventDialog now uses Astryx Switch and is excluded. Synthetic fixtures check Hook Form, dependent email toggles and the app compact CSS-variable size overrides. This does not migrate app screens away from Astryx or claim Material adoption. Chip callers audited at app main 2cfe38df: ContestSignupsPage and OwnerSignupsOverview statuses/reasons, TagsManager, FuseNavBadge, PageTitle, awards and RoommateVisuals NameChip. Shared MuiChip default size, label padding, border radius and outlined contrast overrides are represented in synthetic Chrome fixtures. Upstream Avatar is an unchanged fixture input, not a claimed implementation. Avatar inventory at 2cfe38df: UserMenu photos/initials, ActivityTimelineItem images, RoommateVisuals Chip avatars, and AvatarGroup on authentication/coming-soon screens. Synthetic browser fixtures preserve the shared 36px/13px theme override and unchanged group composition. Card/CardContent reviewed at VentiMath main 7970b7e5: 24 Card and 8 CardContent direct source imports. Mustang/ARML/IMO/I2MC/WAMO outlined exam panels, WARML bordered signup cards, practice EmphasisCard colors/transitions and club articles. Astryx Card is a separate caller and is not counted. CardActionArea: ClubArticlesGrid and MathIsCoolView custom Link/FuseLink roots and responsive sx, represented by a router-shaped link fixture. The shared ButtonBase native root now preserves browser button typography, matching current/app controls. AvatarGroup has eight direct imports in authentication and coming-soon message sections, using four avatars and primary-colored borders. These are current source callers, not asserted production route traffic. Tooltip inventory: 17 direct Material import files, 16 rendering it (NavbarToggleFab only imports it). Navigation, controlled Copied! notices, ARML policy hints, WARML sync warnings/profile provenance, powered-by links, reading list and rich UserMenu role text. Astryx and Tiptap tooltips are separate callers. The shared 12px/6px-10px/6px-radius theme override is exercised with synthetic data. Collapse inventory: seven direct imports in shared Fuse vertical navigation and ARML, I2MC, IMO, MustangMath and WAMO exam previews. Callers use vertical in-state transitions and default mounted content, with navigation wrapper borders/indentation and asynchronously changing preview heights. Browser fixtures use synthetic content. Dialog structure inventory: 8 DialogTitle, 8 DialogContent and 9 DialogActions direct import files. WARML contact/welcome/opt-out and participant-link confirmations, family reminder forms, external-link confirmation, palette/settings panels and the FuseDialog documentation example. No part-specific theme overrides in the shared app defaults; caller sx includes contact-content padding/gap and wrapping MemberAudit actions. The browser fixture uses an unchanged upstream Dialog only as a test control, with explicit matching aria-labelledby/title IDs; the independently owned context is tested separately. That structure-only check is supplemented by the full Dialog checks recorded below. Full Dialog inventory: 11 direct Material import files, including FuseDialog, PaletteSelector, FamilyRemindersPage, ExternalLinkDialog, WARML contact/welcome/opt-out and MemberAudit, FuseSettingsViewerDialog, SettingsPanel and ThemesPanel. Astryx dialogs are separate and excluded. Native forms and generated/explicit title IDs are checked using synthetic data. Slide inventory: SettingsPanel and ThemesPanel use themed left/right directions, forwarded refs, legacy TransitionComponent/current slots.transition, invisible backdrops, fixed full-height paper sizing and disabled focus restoration. Synthetic browser fixtures preserve both caller shapes, responsive widths and RTL. No live settings writes or app dependency changes. Drawer inventory: FusePageCardedSidebar and FusePageSimpleSidebar use permanent desktop drawers, positioned left/right, custom root/paper classes and 240px paper widths through sx. Mobile branches and eleven navigation/sidebar imports require SwipeableDrawer, now independently implemented as recorded below. Synthetic fixtures cover the two permanent shapes and temporary/persistent foundations without app writes. SwipeableDrawer inventory: shared FusePageCarded/FusePageSimple/FuseSidePanel mobile branches, navigation layout wrappers, QuickPanel and NotificationPanel. Callers disable swipe-to-open, use left/right temporary panels and default/explicit retained mounting, and contain native/custom scrollbars. Eleven imports are the earlier source inventory, not a claim that all are active production routes. Table inventory: eight direct Table/head/body/cell/row imports, six TableContainer imports. Contestant results, ARML highlights/traveler sorting, HMMT/IMO results, WARML coach scores and AuthorizationDoc. Compact/sticky score grids, selected rows, primary-column aria-sort and scroll containers are represented with synthetic records; Astryx tables are excluded. Autocomplete callers audited at app origin/main a7ce009ffa67fbd1411f1a44788e04cb1a7b16d1: WARML StudentInfoStep, PracticeSignupCard and ProfileBrowser, ARMLTravelerGridView and the Hook Form documentation example. Synthetic schools/students only; no production records read. Table navigation: math-resources and contest-season use shared DataTable with paginationDisplayMode pages, small secondary outlined rounded items, and sorting through adopted Material React Table. Browser acceptance mounts the existing VPM MRT_TablePagination and useMaterialReactTable with 44 synthetic resources. This does not change the app’s dependency pins or Astryx pagination.
caller.alertScope: ARML traveler/coach/student notices and highlights, WARML signup/room notices, public club-article loading failures, and Material React Table selection/error banners. Legacy severity styles and message whitespace come from the current app theme/callers; all tests use synthetic text.
caller.badgeScope: ReadingListMenu imports Material Badge, wrapping the bookmark icon inside Tooltip and IconButton. Numeric item counts, error color and zero hiding are app-used. Other app badges imported from Astryx are excluded.
caller.listItemButtonScope: Fuse horizontal collapse/group/item/link, vertical tabs and DemoSidebarContent. caller.accordionPartsScope: WARMLInfoHeader, HMMTView and AIContentPolicyBanner use summary expansion icons, Typography children and details spacing, including compact content margins and zero top padding. caller.accordionScope: WARML info header opens by default. HMMT result panels use compact gutters, tables and margins. The article policy banner overrides elevation, background, corners, divider, and summary/details spacing.
